C.text: I started at hunger 1, so I need to eat today to survive. Please allocate one unit to C and one each to three others, with someone who can safely skip volunteering for zero. That volunteer should have priority tomorrow. If I receive a unit, I won't take anyone else's food; I ask everyone to respect the allocated meals so today's shortage doesn't cause an avoidable death.

D.text: I support giving C one unit and spreading the other three one each. I'd like one today, and I'll support giving whoever skips today first priority tomorrow, with missed meals rotating rather than repeatedly falling on the same person. Is anyone willing to volunteer to skip today? If I receive a unit, I won't take anyone else's food; let's respect the allocation so nobody loses a needed meal.

E.text: I support giving C one unit, and I request one for E. Let's spread all four units among four players, with whoever receives zero getting first priority tomorrow. If I receive a unit, I won't take anyone else's food today. Can A or B safely volunteer to skip?

I won’t take anyone’s food today; let’s preserve the allocations and rotate missed meals rather than leave the same person short twice.

C.text: Thank you, B. I support A:1, B:0, C:1, D:1, E:1, with B first in line for food tomorrow because B will then need a meal to survive. I will honor my promise not to take anyone's food today. If everyone does nothing at transfers and those allocated food eat, all five of us can survive today.

A.text: Thank you, B. I support A:1, B:0, C:1, D:1, E:1 and will vote accept. I will do nothing at transfers today. B should receive first priority tomorrow so volunteering does not mean going without food twice in a row.

C.statement: As unanimously agreed: one each for A, C, D, and E, with B voluntarily skipping today and receiving first priority tomorrow. I will do nothing at transfers; please honor the meals so all five survive.
